split_policy: seed 42; shuffle scene groups formed by 9x8 grayscale dHash with Hamming distance <=4; 70/15/15; no near-duplicate component crosses splits
metadata_annotation_match: all selected YOLO rows match fixed Metadata.csv class IDs and normalized boxes
pixel_transform: none; selected fixed-version generated original photos are copied unchanged

visual_review.findings: geometric stationery objects match labels; camera-photo sample shows no people; visible product names/logos occur on stationery; screenshot captures were excluded after a visible image-search overlay was found in the source candidate

rights_review.license: CC BY 4.0 displayed on official Mendeley Data v1 page
rights_review.image_origin: dataset page states authors photographed geometric tools with smartphones in Dhaka stationery shops and libraries
rights_review.third_party_content: some sampled stationery displays product branding; included incidentally as part of author-captured scenes and not an endorsement; third-party trademarks remain subject to their owners' rights

image_decode_method: macOS sips; 640x640 for all selected images

education_review.suggested_project: study-desk geometry-tool inventory or finding misplaced drawing tools
limitations: photos were collected in Dhaka and are not a representative sample of Japanese stationery or classroom scenes
some augmented variants in the publisher-provided splits cross source-photo groups; all augmented variants are excluded here
small source-photo subset; scores should not be treated as reliable real-world performance
visible product brands are incidental and do not indicate endorsement
